svg.title: FreeCAD SVG Export
svg.desc: Drawing page: Page001 exported from FreeCAD document: garden_room_v2

g.text: Note: Site is an existing level residential garden. Ground level variation across the 3.6m footprint is negligible (<1 degree).
Maximum building height is calculated from the highest adjacent ground level (Datum Zero)
to ensure strict compliance with the 2.5m Permitted Development boundary height limit.
